campaign: Deterministic RSI storage and execution control plane
doctrine: OvergoDB remains the sole canonical artifact transaction authority. Modularization separates a small hash-chained metadata journal, immutable content-addressed blobs, compiled Go projections and checkpoints, and bounded operational coordination while preserving artifact.Repository, global ordering, atomic batches, alias compare-and-set, lineage validation, read-only refresh, backup, retention, and deterministic replay. High-volume observations are chunked into blobs and committed through bounded summaries; heartbeats, wake signals, and partial process output remain operational unless they cause a meaningful durable transition. Multica and semantic-router are used only as independently re-expressed inventories of operational problems and observable behavior: no source, schema, file format, runtime, Markdown skill, plugin mechanism, or product layer is copied. RSI additions use typed versioned Go records, existing Overgo owners, derived distribution-free decisions, explicit missing-data coverage, and architecture tests that refuse bypasses. Interaction efficiency is an external behavior: equal or better task capability with fewer semantic commits, projection scans, bytes, wakeups, context repetitions, model turns, tool calls, retries, and waits. Every optimization starts from a measured representative interaction trace, preserves exact admitted inputs and evidence, consolidates common policy or mechanics, and deletes the displaced path in the same commit. Efficiency work additionally minimizes processing and memory movement: bounded streaming reads over full-content copies, deltas over rebuilds, and reuse over reload, each admitted only through the measured efficiency gate. The absorbed composition campaign builds only the driver that sequences existing, tested composition owners (organ, tensorcatalog, composition, bridgetrain, modelmerge, synthesis) toward the multidimensional improvement fitness: no new model-unique code, components stay prototype and recipe data, every composite candidate is advisory until ablation-gated fitness-scored promotion through the existing composition promotion path, an average-only win cannot promote, HDC search stays shelved until the exact-index scan is the measured bottleneck, donor shortlists use the exact normalized catalog with the bias-audited alignment residual as the seam proxy, and driver budget, saturation, and every threshold derive from measured history rather than free knobs. Development pace doctrine: work lands as one gated commit per task, where a task is a single step or a short series of steps sized by its verification surface — a broad surface splits so every gate run stays cheap and attributable, and work never accumulates ungated across tasks. After every gated completion the plan is refactored in the same turn from the landed result, gate advisories, and any new understanding: re-scope, re-rank, add, or set-verify before the next dispatch, so the plan stays the current best hypothesis rather than a backlog. A gate refusal whose fix is deterministic must name or perform that fix; throughput work that shortens the gate itself is admitted under the same measured-evidence rules as every other efficiency claim. The plan is the single prioritized inventory of planned work: item order is dispatch priority, related steps stay grouped in one item, parked findings graduate into plan rows rather than living only in the findings ledger, and a mechanical action the model repeats across turns becomes a Go-owned automation row instead of standing grunt work.

items.title: Comprehensive smoke of every local complete model: inference, training, and lm-eval benchmarks, with regressions corrected

steps.title: Run one bounded recorded training step per model with an active or bootstrappable training recipe and correct any regression
steps.rationale: Build the train-lane over the capability catalog: every model with an active training-task recipe gets one bounded training step with frozen lexical tensors, recorded to the store as a run. Models without a training activation are reported as uncovered, never silently skipped. Fix regressions the lane surfaces; park larger findings with cmd/finding.

steps.title: Evaluate every servable model against one derived lm-eval suite family and correct any regression
steps.rationale: The store's derived benchmark suites are the lm-eval substrate; one bounded family per model proves the whole path — suite derivation, per-model prompt templates, session evaluation, and evidence publication — still works for every servable model. Fix regressions and measured inefficiencies the run surfaces; park larger findings with cmd/finding.

steps.title: Register models/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q6_K into OvergoDB and verify its declared multimodal capabilities
steps.rationale: Owner request 2026-08-30: register the local Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q6_K.gguf (qwen35 architecture, 22 GB Q6_K mix) through the standard intake — activate its inference recipe with verified evidence — then read the model documentation saved beside the artifact and verify each multimodal capability it declares through the corresponding task activations, recording evidence per capability. The smoke lane must then serve it green alongside the existing matrix.

items.title: Graduate parked findings into gated cleanups

steps.title: Consolidate the per-document codec idiom so new record types stop growing the clone ceiling
steps.rationale: The identical New/Parse/Batch wrappers now span 20+ document types (exact-clone group of 21 nodes) and every new typed record raises docs/clone_baseline.json by ~21 nodes. Migrate the wrappers onto shared DocumentCodec methods, delete the displaced copies, and lower the reviewed ceiling below 10000 in the same commit.

steps.title: Retire or migrate pre-contract work-lease documents so the lease report reads the live set
steps.rationale: The store holds work-lease documents written before the current lease contract; lease-report refuses on them while the frontier merely counts them as legacy-unreadable. Retire them through a reviewed CAS or migrate them to canonical replacements so both readers serve the live set.

steps.title: Consolidate the cloneRef and cloneCommitID exact clone into one owner
steps.rationale: The gate's review advisory names an exact clone between apimanifest cloneRef and overgodb cloneCommitID. If the copy semantics are one contract, one owner keeps it, callers migrate, and the displaced path is deleted in the same commit; if they are genuinely distinct, the census decision records why.

steps.title: Decide the unplanned reference paper in docs and pin that docs holds no unplanned binaries
steps.rationale: An arXiv paper sits untracked in docs and every gate run warns about it. Either ship it with a citation as planned reference material or delete it, then pin the decision with a check that docs holds no untracked binary documents, so future reference material enters through a plan row.

items.title: Enforce the Go-only RSI architecture and prove the storage transition end to end

steps.title: Extend and re-run the permanent authority ratchet over completed RSI entry points
steps.rationale: Extend the same early always-required, manifest-owned gate ratchet over the newly created model, recipe, routing, rollout, and safety authorities. Re-run its architecture contract after convergence; do not create a second guard process or policy owner.

steps.title: Re-run the permanent Go-only ratchet against the completed RSI surface
steps.rationale: Re-run the same early Go-only ratchet after every planned extension exists. Prompts and descriptions remain typed artifact data, but Markdown skills, plugin manifests, embedded interpreters, runtime scripts, and filesystem discovery cannot grant capabilities or alter runtime semantics; no duplicate check is introduced.

steps.title: Rebuild a legacy store into segmented journal, blob, and projection layout and execute backup, restore, retention, and rollback drills
steps.rationale: The drill uses the pinned compatibility and scale corpus, compares query and content digests, injects interruption at each publication boundary, opens the destination read-only, and proves the source remains untouched and recoverable.

steps.title: Run one prototype through model and recipe materialization, execution, evaluation, rollout, live regression, atomic rollback, and reproducible explanation
steps.rationale: Acceptance requires externally visible control behavior, not only new record types: admitted prototype, compiled Go construction, resolved model definition, validated task recipe, exact strategy identity, semantically relevant typed references, exact capability placement, bounded stimuli, terminal attempt evidence, explicit missing and degraded coverage states under shared fact, chunk, and raw-byte budgets, resource comparison, measured interaction reduction without lost work, deterministic cohorting, live containment, and causal evidence reproduced after cold rebuild.

steps.title: Re-run common-code and policy-copy census and record the campaign tightening delta
steps.rationale: The campaign closes only if shared components replaced duplicate process, publication, failure, retry, capability, trigger, resource, query, reconciliation, and storage mechanics rather than adding parallel frameworks. The measured census and interaction-trace delta live in OvergoDB and the plan retains no completion ledger.
